Extract Components from Seasonal Adjustment Objects

Source: R/extract_cmp.R
components.Rd

Extract Components from Seasonal Adjustment Objects

Usage

seasonal(x, forecast = FALSE, calendar = FALSE, seas_freq = NULL, ...)

trendcycle(x, forecast = FALSE, ...)

irregular(x, forecast = FALSE, corrected = FALSE, ...)

seasonaladj(x, forecast = FALSE, corrected = FALSE, ...)

calendaradj(x, forecast = FALSE, spec = NULL, ...)

calendar(x, forecast = FALSE, spec = NULL, ...)

raw(x, forecast = FALSE, backcast = FALSE, spec = NULL, ...)

Arguments

x

A seasonal adjustment model (from rjd3x13, rjd3tramoseats, or rjd3highfreq).

forecast, backcast

Logicals indicating whether the forecast or backcast series should be returned. If forecast = TRUE and backcast = TRUE, the function only returns the forecast series. Default is FALSE. Ignored for rjd3highfreq objects.

calendar

If TRUE, seasonal() returns the seasonal and calendar components. Ignored for rjd3highfreq objects.

seas_freq

For methods with multiple seasonal frequencies (rjd3highfreq::multi_airline_decomposition(), rjd3highfreq::istl() or rjd3highfreq::mstl()), the seasonal frequency to extract. If NULL, the first seasonal frequency is returned.

...

Additional arguments passed to methods.

corrected

If TRUE, large extreme values are removed from the components. Ignored for rjd3tramoseats and rjd3highfreq objects.

spec

The specification used to estimate the model. Only used for "JD3_TRAMOSEATS_OUTPUT" objects for functions calendaradj(), calendar() and raw() (when forecast = FALSE and backast = TRUE) because the output doesn't contain the desired component and the specification.

Value

A ts object (or a vector of numeric for "hf_decomposition" objects) containing the requested component.

A ts object with the requested component.

Details

These functions are S3 generics supporting several classes from the rjdverse ecosystem:

  • X-13 models (rjd3x13): JD3_X13_OUTPUT, JD3_X13_RSLTS, JD3_Object;

  • TRAMO-SEATS models (rjd3tramoseats): JD3_TRAMOSEATS_OUTPUT, JD3_TRAMOSEATS_RSLTS;

  • High-frequency decompositions (rjd3highfreq): hf_decomposition (except for calendaradj() and calendar(), which are not supported for this class).

Examples

model <- rjd3x13::jx13(ipi_c_eu[, "FR"])
seasonal(model)
